notes.title: Next Fest Demo Update!
notes.content:
The Bad Mechanic Demo has received a big fat update for Steam Next Fest! The number of towers has more than doubled, status effects like poison and stun have been added, and the game has become much more challenging and strategical!

Here are some towers you can expect in the new demo:
[list]
[*] Sushi Truck - Poisons enemies with questionable sushi
[*] Tower Factory - Spawns moving towers that shoot enemies
[*] Bumper - Reflects bullets that come into contact
[*] Money Printer - Prints money at the end of each round
[*] Freeze Ray - Freezes multiple enemies at once with laser blasts
[/list]
...and more!

play it it's fun

notes.title: The Demo Is Live!
notes.content:
The Demo is available to play on Steam RIGHT NOW! Big Ass Zombie has been replaced with Big Business, a more intimidating and muscular foe. The game is actively being worked on & the demo will receive a few updates down the road. Join the Discord if you'd like to contribute your feedback / ideas: https://discord.gg/xcsY5BCuTt

notes.title: Playtest #1
notes.content:
Participate in our first playtest on steam! This is a once in a lifetime to play against Big Ass Zombie (the temporary boss I made specifically for this playtest)

The playtest will be open from February 24th at 10:00 AM to February 26th 10:00 PM (EST)
